startups.title: Ndea
startups.description: AGI lab merging deep learning with program synthesis — a direct bet against the scaling hypothesis. $43M raised. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** ndea.com | **Twitter:** @ndea | **YC slug:** ndea-com

Founded by [Francois Chollet](./Francois%20Chollet.md) and [Mike Knoop](./Mike%20Knoop.md). Team of 15. YC partner: Tyler Bosmeny.

Entered YC W26 having already raised **$43M** — the largest pre-program raise in the entire batch. Goal: create a "factory for rapid scientific advancement" capable of autonomous invention and discovery across drug discovery, robotics, energy, and space.

Ndea's thesis diverges sharply from the mainstream scaling consensus. Where frontier labs bet on larger models trained on more data, Ndea bets on **program synthesis**: systems that discover and compose explicit programs to solve problems, rather than pattern-matching from training data.

Chollet and Knoop are also co-founders of the ARC Prize Foundation — offering $1M annual prizes for AI systems that pass the ARC-AGI benchmark, a test that current LLMs consistently fail. Ndea is the commercial expression of that conviction.

[Synthetic Sciences](./Synthetic%20Sciences.md) and [Origin Bio](./Origin%20Bio.md) operate in the same AI-for-science space from different angles; Ndea's contribution is the foundational model architecture rather than the application layer.

startups.title: Synthetic Sciences
startups.description: Infrastructure for scientific superintelligence — AI co-scientists for full research workflows. 92% on BixBench. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** syntheticsciences.ai | **Twitter:** @SynScience | **GitHub:** github.com/synthetic-sciences | **LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/company/synsci

Founded by [Aayam Bansal](./Aayam%20Bansal.md) and [Ishaan Gangwani](./Ishaan%20Gangwani.md). Team of 2. YC partner: Gustaf Alstromer. Backed by a16z Scout Fund ($1.4M pre-YC + $500K YC = $1.9M total).

Scored **92% on BixBench** — a biology-specific reasoning benchmark. "Claude Code for science."

Enables AI co-scientists to autonomously handle: literature synthesis, hypothesis generation, experiment design, code execution, data analysis, and publication-ready output. High-fidelity evaluations and RL environments for long-horizon scientific research.

The founding age (both ~18) is a data point, not a gimmick. Gangwani is International Olympiad in AI 2025 (Honorable Mention), USACO Platinum (top 0.01% globally). Bansal has published at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAA, CVPR — rare credentials for any founder, exceptional for an 18-year-old.

Both are Z-Fellows and Emergent Ventures recipients — independent signals of exceptional technical ability.

[Ndea](./Ndea.md) bets on the model architecture layer; Synthetic Sciences bets on the application layer that makes AI agents do real scientific work now, with existing models.

startups.title: Thesis
startups.description: Autonomous AI research — machines that discover machines. YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://thesislabs.ai | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/thesis

Thesis is an AI research lab automating AI R&D itself. Building Darwin, a hill-climbing machine that searches vast combinatorial spaces of experiments. By using the outcome of every experiment to optimize the next, Darwin turns ML research into a compounding system rather than a sequence of manual attempts.

Directed toward the grand challenges of biology and materials science. Mission: build the machine that discovers the next Transformer, the next AlphaFold, and the breakthroughs that push science and engineering to the absolute frontier.

startups.title: ARC Prize Foundation
startups.description: AI benchmarks that measure general intelligence. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://arcprize.org | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/arc-prize-foundation

ARC Prize builds AI benchmarks that measure general intelligence. Their benchmark, ARC-AGI, has been used by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and xAI.

Founded by Mike Knoop and François Chollet. Through benchmarks, global competitions, research grants, and community, ARC Prize guides researchers, industry, and regulators on the path to AGI. Thesis: AGI requires more than scaling — it demands systems capable of genuine fluid intelligence and adaptation to novel challenges.

startups.title: Sciloop
startups.description: Expert STEM reasoning data for frontier AI labs. YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://sciloop.dev | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/sciloop

Sciloop creates expert-level math and physics problems that frontier AI models can't solve, then sells the data to AI labs for training and evaluation. Problems are created by IPhO and IMO medalists — the top 0.01% of STEM talent globally.

On their benchmark, models like GPT 5.4 Pro and Gemini 3.1 Pro score 0–5% on the hardest problems. Founded by Bilal and Osman, International Physics Olympiad medalists from MIT with ML research experience at MIT CSAIL.

startups.title: Multifactor
startups.description: Zero-trust auth and authorization for AI agents with patented prompt injection defense. $15M raised. YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** multifactor.com | **Twitter:** @multifactorcom | **LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/company/multifactorcom

Founded by [Vivek Nair](./Vivek%20Nair.md) and [Colin Roberts](./Colin%20Roberts.md). San Francisco. Team of 6. YC partner: Nicolas Dessaigne.

Raised **$15M** — largest funding round in the F25 batch. Vivek Nair turned down substantial VC term sheets to go through YC instead.

Enterprise customers include manufacturing supply chain operators managing **$7.5B+** in assets.

Provides fine-grained, auditable, zero-trust authentication specifically for AI agents: "checkpoint links" that let agents share online accounts without exposing passwords, with patented defense against prompt injection attacks.

When an agent calls an API or executes a database query, existing systems either grant it full user permissions (too broad) or no permissions (useless). Multifactor provides per-operation authorization with audit trails — the security primitive the agentic stack was missing.

Natural stack with [Metorial](./Metorial.md) (agent-to-tool connections) and [Browser Use](./Browser%20Use.md) (browser control) — Metorial routes agents, Multifactor controls what agents are authorized to do, Browser Use executes.

startups.title: Metorial
startups.description: Enterprise MCP platform connecting Claude Code, Cursor and 600+ integrations with sub-second boot. "Vercel for MCP." YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** metorial.com | **Twitter:** @MetorialAi | **GitHub:** github.com/metorial | **LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/company/metorial

Founded by [Karim Rahme](./Karim%20Rahme.md) and [Tobias Herber](./Tobias%20Herber.md). Vienna, Austria. Team of 4.

Flagship product **Magic MCP** connects MCP clients — Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop — to 600+ integrations with enterprise-grade security, scaling, observability, and sub-second boot times.

MCP (Model Context Protocol, released by Anthropic) is the emerging standard for how AI agents connect to external tools and APIs. Metorial provides the serverless runtime layer: idle servers hibernate and resume with sub-second cold starts, connections are secured and monitored, enterprise compliance requirements are met.

The Vercel analogy is precise: Vercel didn't invent deployment, it made Next.js reliable at enterprise scale. Metorial does the same for MCP — the protocol exists and works at small scale; Metorial makes it work where enterprises require it.

Natural stack with [Multifactor](./Multifactor.md) (what agents are allowed to do) and [Browser Use](./Browser%20Use.md) (how agents control browsers). [S2](./S2.md) handles the streaming data layer beneath.

startups.title: RunAnywhere
startups.description: Fastest on-device AI inference for Apple Silicon, beating Apple's MLX. 10K GitHub stars. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** runanywhere.ai | **Docs:** docs.runanywhere.ai | **GitHub:** RunanywhereAI/runanywhere-sdks (10,100+ stars)

Founded by [Sanchit Monga](./Sanchit%20Monga.md) and [Shubham Malhotra](./Shubham%20Malhotra.md). San Francisco. Team of 5.

Inference engine for Apple Silicon that outperforms Apple's own MLX framework. Single SDK for multimodal AI models running fully on-device, with a central control plane for model rollouts, versioning, and access policies across thousands of devices — no cloud required.

Shubham Malhotra built MetalRT — the first complete multimodal inference engine for Apple Silicon — before RunAnywhere. That specific prior work is the technical moat: most founders approaching on-device AI don't have GPU kernel optimisation experience. Malhotra does.

Sanchit Monga comes from Intuit where he built mobile SDKs used by 50M+ active users. The combination of kernel-level performance expertise (Malhotra) and SDK distribution experience (Monga) is the right founding pair for this product.

The 10K GitHub stars at seed stage places RunAnywhere alongside [Browser Use](./Browser%20Use.md) as one of the most developer-resonant W25/W26 launches.

startups.title: S2
startups.description: Serverless API for streaming real-time data to collaborative AI applications. YC F25.
startups.prose:
Founded by Stephen Balogh, Shikhar Bhushan, and Dwarak Govind Parthiban. Raised $3.85M. Builds the infrastructure layer for streaming data feeds — real-time events that collaborative and agentic applications need to stay in sync across users and agents simultaneously.

The problem: as AI applications become multi-agent and collaborative, the data transport layer matters as much as the model. WebSockets and polling were built for simpler use cases. S2 provides a serverless, globally distributed streaming primitive designed for the latency and reliability requirements of AI workloads.

Comparable positioning to how [Byteport](./Byteport.md) solves the network transport problem and [Metorial](./Metorial.md) solves the agent connection problem — S2 solves the data stream problem in the same emerging AI infrastructure stack.

startups.title: Byteport
startups.description: File transfer protocol delivering 10x faster speeds than TCP, 1000x improvement on unreliable networks. YC W26.
startups.prose:
Built a new file transfer protocol that claims 10x faster speeds than TCP under normal conditions and 1000x improvement on unreliable, high-latency networks. TCP's congestion control algorithm was designed in 1988 for a world of wired connections; it performs poorly on satellite, mobile, and international links.

The benchmark claims are large enough to be skeptical of until independently verified — but the problem space is real. QUIC (used in HTTP/3) already demonstrated that TCP's assumptions are limiting. Byteport is betting that file transfer specifically has worse assumptions and more room to improve than general web traffic.

Practical applications: large model downloads, training data transfers, cross-region backup, multi-site content delivery. All of these are bottlenecked by the same TCP assumptions that Byteport targets.

Sits alongside [RunAnywhere](./RunAnywhere.md) and [S2](./S2.md) in the AI infrastructure layer — all three making the physical movement of data faster and more reliable as AI workloads demand more of the network.

startups.title: SF Tensor
startups.description: Infrastructure for AI labs to focus on research. YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://sf-tensor.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/sf-tensor

SF Tensor is building two products for AI researchers. First, Elastic Cloud: a managed platform that automatically finds the cheapest GPUs across all providers, handles spot instance preemption, and cuts compute costs by up to 80%. Second, automatic kernel optimization that makes training code run faster by modeling hardware topology — often beating hand-tuned implementations.

Founded by researchers who trained their own models across thousands of GPUs and spent more time fighting infrastructure than doing actual research.

startups.title: Unsiloed AI
startups.description: API for parsing multimodal unstructured data. YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://www.unsiloed.ai | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/unsiloed-ai

AI teams spend 6+ months building document workflows, yet fewer than 10% ever reach production. Generic LLM parsers and OCR collapse on multimodal documents with text, tables, images, and charts.

Unsiloed AI has built state-of-the-art vision models as infrastructure for turning unstructured data into structured, queryable, LLM-ready assets. Parses hundreds of thousands of documents for startups and NASDAQ-listed enterprises. On public benchmarks, consistently outperforms LlamaIndex, Gemini, Mistral, and Unstructured.io.

startups.title: Overshoot
startups.description: AI infrastructure for real-time vision applications. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://overshoot.ai | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/overshoot

Overshoot makes it easy for developers to build and run real-time vision applications. 300+ developers connect live video feeds to a large collection of Vision Language Models with 3 lines of code, getting responses in under 200ms — 10x faster than existing inference platforms.

Target applications: physical security, safety, gaming, robotics, consumer products. Solves the core problem of slow inference and model unavailability that breaks real-time vision use cases at scale.

startups.title: Sourcebot
startups.description: Helping humans and AI agents understand massive codebases. YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://www.sourcebot.dev | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/sourcebot

Sourcebot is an open-source code understanding platform for massive codebases. Used by thousands of engineers at NVIDIA, Red Hat, Wikimedia, and Arista Networks.

Understanding code — not writing it — is the primary bottleneck for large engineering teams. Sourcebot gives developers and AI agents the ability to regex search across millions of lines of code instantly, and ask questions across thousands of repos using any flagship reasoning model. Open-source and on-prem, deployed in enterprises within minutes.

startups.title: Hyperspell
startups.description: Your Company Brain. YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://hyperspell.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/hyperspell

Hyperspell is the Company Brain for AI agents. Connects your tools and synthesizes documents and conversations into a live, permissioned context graph. Any agent can read from it and write back to it like a filesystem, with every fact traced to source.

AI agents are brilliant and clueless — they ace any test and have no idea how your company works. Hyperspell fixes this by giving agents the institutional knowledge they need to operate correctly. Team of 8.

startups.title: Nessie
startups.description: Shared context layer for you, your team, and your agents. YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://nessielabs.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/nessie

Nessie is the infrastructure that makes AI thinking permanent. Auto-syncs AI conversations and agent traces across every major provider — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude Code, Codex, and more — turning them into a context layer that is queryable, reusable, and shareable.

No browser extension. No manual capture. Thinking flows in automatically and compounds over time. Addresses the core problem: every AI session starts from zero, so reasoning behind decisions and the evolution of ideas across hundreds of conversations evaporates.

startups.title: Carrot Labs
startups.description: AI Cost Management across every provider. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://superpenguin.ai | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/carrot-labs

AI has become one of the largest and fastest-growing line items for companies, with spend scattered across a dozen provider consoles that each show one number at month-end. Carrot Labs (SuperPenguin) tracks AI spend across 14 providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, AWS Bedrock, Azure, Modal, Cursor, and more.

Answers questions like: which customers are unprofitable once you subtract AI costs? Which feature is burning your Anthropic budget? Is this spike a runaway loop or real growth?

startups.title: Cumulus Labs
startups.description: The Fastest Multimodal Inference OS. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://cumuluslabs.io | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/cumulus-labs

Cumulus Labs lets engineering teams ship AI in production without needing a dedicated ML platform team. Right now, companies building AI products are forced to stitch together separate vendors for routing, observability, evaluation, fine-tuning, and inference. This fragmented approach is brittle, expensive, and is a common reason enterprises fail with AI.

Cumulus Labs replaces that entire stack with a single unified platform. Developers can keep their existing code while instantly upgrading to a unified platform that handles routing, semantic caching, continuous shadow evaluation, simulated data, and one-click fine-tuning.

Behind the platform is Ion, its proprietary inference engine running on a custom NVIDIA Grace GPU fleet. Ion uses in-house custom GPU kernels to deliver 30 to 50 percent more throughput than standard vLLM or SGLang, giving its customers SOTA inference economics.

startups.title: Sentrial
startups.description: Datadog for Agent Reliability. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://sentrial.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/sentrial

Sentrial is the monitoring platform for AI products in production.

When your AI product/agent loops indefinitely, hallucinates, or frustrates users, Sentrial detects it in real-time, diagnoses the root cause, and recommends specific fixes. Sentrial provides the monitoring, evaluation, and debugging infrastructure that traditional tools weren't built for, so teams iterate based on production reality, not just offline evals.

startups.title: shortkit
startups.description: Media infra for consumer apps. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://www.shortkit.dev | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/shortkit

ShortKit lets any consumer app launch a TikTok-grade media expereinces.

Michael, spent 6 years at YouTube building the infrastructure that powers YouTube Shorts. Neil, prev. scaled a SaaS company from 0 to $6M ARR as employee #1.

shortkit handles the full media stack, starting with short form video - client SDKs, video infrastructure, rec systems, and monetization - so product teams don't have to.

startups.title: Crosslayer Labs
startups.description: Protect, monitor and defend your Internet presence. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://www.crosslayerlabs.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/crosslayer-labs

Crosslayer Labs detects impersonation attacks on websites and APIs. Crosslayer Labs provides "outside-in" monitoring of customer infrastructure, comprehensively discovering and monitoring all Internet dependencies, including DNS, BGP, TLS certs, Javascript. It correlates signals from different layers of the Internet stack to identify attack patterns. Its alerts are actionable and contain root cause analysis/remediation recommendations. Its founding team is world renowned for previously inventing the MPIC standard adopted by all the major CAs including Google, Apple, Amazon. The MPIC standard is securing over 700 million websites via the issuance of over 3 billion digital certificates, and is now a global internet standard that protects every single HTTPS connection.

startups.title: Antigen
startups.description: Continuous offensive security for the enterprise. YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://antigen.sh | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/antigen

Antigen is an AI adversary for the enterprise. Maps, exploits, and secures your attack surface through nightly automated offensive testing and monthly human red team assessments. Every finding is delivered with traces, reproduction steps, and remediation directly in GitHub or Linear.

Backed by Lightspeed, DST Global, and Susa Ventures. Works with companies in financial services, healthcare, retail, and government where security is trust. Positions itself as the always-on red team.

startups.title: Parameter
startups.description: Agentic Offensive Security at Scale. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://parameter.ai | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/parameter-fka-hex-security

Parameter builds AI agents that run continuous penetration tests against your apps and infrastructure. Instead of a once-a-year penetration test, Parameter's agents work 24/7 to find and verify critical vulnerabilities before attackers do.

Formerly Hex Security. Team of 10. The shift from annual pentests to continuous automated offensive security is the key product bet — the threat landscape changes faster than annual testing cycles.

startups.title: Hypercubic
startups.description: Agentic AI for Mainframe Operations and Modernization. YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://www.hypercubic.ai | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/hypercubic

Hypercubic is an AI-native platform for mainframe operations and modernization. About 70% of Fortune 500 companies still rely on mainframes built in the 1960s–90s to run core business applications in banking, insurance, telecom, airlines, and retail.

These systems have become increasingly opaque as original developers retire. Hypercubic pioneers a new class of intelligence capable of understanding, reasoning about, and rebuilding the world's foundational infrastructure.

startups.title: AnswerThis
startups.description: End-to-end workspace to accelerate scientific discovery. YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://answerthis.io | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/answerthis

AnswerThis is a scientific discovery platform used by over 200,000 researchers that reduces weeks of manual research work to hours. Instead of manually searching, reading, and organizing dozens of papers, researchers find the most relevant work, see how ideas are connected, and get comprehensive answers to complex scientific questions.

Allows researchers to map research gaps, analyze trends, and draft literature reviews far faster — all while building a searchable library of their own research materials.

startups.title: Aside
startups.description: The browser built to do real work for you. YC F25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://aside.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/aside

Aside is an AI browser that completes real work across the websites you already use — signing in through your browser, working inside email, dashboards, internal tools, docs, and spreadsheets. Continues working when a task takes minutes or hours.

Achieved state-of-the-art on agentic browsing benchmarks, surpassing OpenAI and Anthropic's results — ranked #1 across Mind2Web, Odyssey, and bu-bench-v1. Unlike agents that depend on integrations, Aside uses the web the same way humans do.

startups.title: Ashr
startups.description: Automated Multi-Modal Testing for Agents. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://ashr.io | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/ashr

Ashr is a fully contained test and evals platform that improves AI agents by ensuring accuracy and quality across a wide range of user journeys through your product.

Ashr generates user journeys through your agents’ tool calls, results, and questions. Ashr dons’t generate one off tests, it generates large amounts of authentic user stories through your product, and pick up on errors, inconsistencies, and failures that would otherwise take hours of manual testing or get caught by a customer. It alsos work to ensure agent response quality in line with your business goals by offering custom evaluation metrics.

Ashr works with voice, text, automated website generation, image, file generation, and multimodal. We’re also willing to generate custom input types or make modifications for anyone interested. Currently, it integrates as an SDK, and are proactively working to make its documentation and resources as accessible and easy to use as possible.

startups.title: Aemon
startups.description: The Forward-Deployed AI Research Engineer. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://aemon.ai/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/aemon

Aemon is the first autonomous research engineer that delivers state-of-the-art solutions to your engineering problems. It generates, tests, and evolves thousands of approaches at machine speed to discover optimal solutions beyond what human experts can find.

Aemon already set a new world record on an NP-hard math optimization problem with <$10 of compute, beating the previous record set by Google DeepMind in 2025.

Ray and Richard (twin brothers) dropped out of UWaterloo and UIUC to build Aemon. They published at top AI conferences like ICLR and EMNLP before turning 20.

startups.title: Browser Use
startups.description: Open-source framework letting AI agents autonomously control browsers. 97K GitHub stars, $17M seed. YC W25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** browser-use.com | **Twitter:** @browser_use | **GitHub:** github.com/gregpr07/browser-use

Founded by [Magnus Muller](./Magnus%20Muller.md) and [Gregor Zunic](./Gregor%20Zunic.md). San Francisco. Both from ETH Zurich.

**97,600+ GitHub stars** — one of the highest star counts ever for a YC company at seed stage. Raised **$17M seed**. Free open-source core + paid Browser Use Cloud.

Provides the framework for AI agents to control web browsers: filling forms, navigating sites, scraping structured data, automating web-based workflows. Unlike Playwright (deterministic test scripts), Browser Use lets an LLM decide how to navigate — handling sites it has never seen before, adapting to UI changes, completing goal-directed tasks without pre-written selectors.

The 97K stars metric tells the real story: developers discovered the tool, found it genuinely useful, and starred it at a rate that indicates real adoption. Open-source projects with that velocity typically have significant B2B revenue within 18 months.

Natural integration with [Metorial](./Metorial.md) (MCP agent orchestration) and [Multifactor](./Multifactor.md) (agent authorization) — together they form the infrastructure stack for safe, production-grade browser-based AI agents.

startups.title: BeeSafe AI
startups.description: Frontier AI Defenses for Social Engineering Attacks. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://beesafe.ai/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/beesafe-ai

BeeSafe AI is building the frontier model layer for social engineering defense. Cyberattacks have moved from code to conversation: attackers now use AI to carry out long-term, trust-based manipulation across SMS, voice, email, and social platforms, often inside encrypted channels where defenders cannot see, detect, or stop them.

BeeSafe changes that by deploying undercover AI agents that engage attackers directly, expose hidden infrastructure, and convert live adversarial conversations into actionable intelligence. Each engagement adds to BeeSafe's proprietary dataset of real attacker behavior and trains foundational models that continually learn about counter-persuasion, deception, and manipulation in the wild.

BeeSafe is starting in financial crime, where banks already value its data against Authorized Push Payment (APP) fraud and money laundering, but the opportunity is far broader. The same data and models that uncover mule networks today can protect consumers, secure enterprises, and strengthen governments against the next generation of AI-powered social engineering attacks tomorrow.

startups.title: BitPatrol
startups.description: BitPatrol uses AI to detect exposed credentials in real time, protecting organizations from high-impact data breaches. YC Sp25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://www.bitpatrol.io/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/bitpatrol

BitPatrol is a B2B cybersecurity startup based in New York City that leverages machine learning to detect exposed credentials in real time.

The company’s AI-powered code security platform helps organizations prevent high-impact data breaches by automatically scanning code for vulnerable secrets. BitPatrol was acquired, underscoring its value to the DevSecOps market.

startups.title: Propolis
startups.description: Hands off QA via intelligent browser agents. YC Sp25.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://propolis.tech/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/propolis

Propolis builds intelligent browser agents that simulate real users to automate QA. It uses swarms of autonomous agents to test web applications, reducing manual testing effort.

Based in New York City with a two‑person team, the B2B company targets enterprises needing efficient quality assurance. Propolis was acquired.

startups.title: Gigacatalyst
startups.description: AI-first embedded analytics and reports for customer success. YC Sp26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://gigacatalyst.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/gigacatalyst

Gigacatalyst lets customers build analytics, dashboards, reports, and forms directly inside their SaaS product. The platform adds an embedded AI customization layer that learns the product’s APIs, enabling users to create tailored visualizations that match their workflows and share them across teams with a single click.

By providing bespoke dashboards for each use case, Gigacatalyst helps customers use their SaaS more, retain longer, and expand sales faster. The company is already live with top Series B firms and reports a 90 % repeat usage rate.

startups.title: Bird
startups.description: An omnichannel communications platform that powers business-to-customer messaging across SMS, voice, and social channels. YC S16.
startups.prose:
**Website:** http://bird.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/bird

Bird provides the foundational infrastructure for business communications, enabling companies to interact with customers across channels such as SMS, Voice, WhatsApp, WeChat, Messenger, and Email. The platform ensures that these interactions occur with the correct context, supporting connections to billions of devices globally.

Headquartered in Amsterdam, the company operates through nine global hubs including locations in Singapore, Dublin, and London. It serves nearly 20,000 customers worldwide and maintains a distributed team of 500 employees representing over 55 nationalities.

startups.title: NuCypher (aka Threshold Network)
startups.description: Pioneering decentralized threshold cryptography and end-to-end encrypted data sharing networks. YC S16.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://threshold.network/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/nucypher-aka-threshold-network

NuCypher, also known as the Threshold Network, is a B2B infrastructure company based in Austin, Texas, that specializes in decentralized threshold cryptography. Since 2017, the team has developed cryptographic primitives for secure data sharing, including Proxy Re-Encryption and Threshold Access Control (TACo), alongside novel cryptoeconomic mechanisms like Stable Yield.

The company’s flagship product, TACo, launched on mainnet in January 2024 and is currently running on over 120 nodes with approximately $80 million in associated economic security. It supports a growing ecosystem of paying developers and major infrastructure partners such as Ceramic, Irys, Textile, and Unlock, maintaining a decentralized architecture from its genesis block.

As one of the two founding teams of the Threshold Network, NuCypher hosts several key protocols including tBTC, Random Beacon, and tUSD. The organization has also implemented original network and governance architectures, including a historic on-chain merger, to support its mission of enhancing privacy and security in decentralized systems.

startups.title: RunKit
startups.description: a sandboxed environment for prototyping server-side JavaScript. YC S16.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://tonicdev.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/runkit

Altair is an AI-native medical billing service for independent practices. Altair Health takes over a practice's billing end to end and get doctors paid by insurers. AI does the work; its billers handle the exceptions.

Before the agent acts on a claim, the prover checks the action against that insurer's policies, and anything that fails goes to one of its billers.

Every claim teaches Altair how each insurer behaves, so the longer it runs a practice's billing, the better it predicts what its insurers will pay, deny or delay.

Every player's game is different; events emerge from agent interactions, not scripted outcomes.

Most historical games use fixed scripts. Pax Historia simulates societies, economies, political dynamics, and individual actors using large language models grounded in historical data.

The 2,334 Twitter likes at launch made it the most-engaged W26 launch on social media — ahead even of [Pocket](./Pocket.md). The 35K DAU is the real metric: people are coming back daily, not just trying it once.

[Synthetic Sciences](./Synthetic%20Sciences.md) simulates scientific research with AI agents. Pax Historia simulates historical societies. The shared architecture insight: LLMs are finally capable enough to maintain coherent, complex simulation state across long sessions.

Solve was acquired, highlighting the market’s interest in streamlined travel logistics.

startups.title: Sable

Newcomers can start building a U.S. credit history from day one, even without a Social Security Number or prior U.S. credit history. The Sable app is available on iOS and Android, and the company is based in New York City with a team of 12. Sable was acquired after its Summer 2019 Y Combinator batch, reflecting its notable position in the fintech and consumer‑finance space.

startups.title: Reflect

Reflect was acquired, highlighting its value in the B2B developer‑tools market. The company, based in Villanova, PA, has a six‑person team and serves B2B, engineering, product, and design customers.

startups.title: Slash

Slash is America’s leading business banking platform, serving over 5,000 mid‑market companies and processing $30 billion of transactions each year across all payment rails. It also supplies free invoicing, expense management, bill‑pay software, stablecoin payments, and a powerful card‑creation and payments API, all available to businesses in more than 100 countries. startups.title: Pulse

Companies such as Salesforce, Microsoft, Okta and Dialpad rely on Pulse to support their strategy, content and marketing teams.

Pulse was acquired, underscoring its impact on the enterprise knowledge space. The company, founded in YC’s Winter 2018 batch, operates out of San Francisco with a team of 11.

startups.title: Landed

By recycling capital as buyers exit the program, Landed builds a self-renewing pool that keeps costs low and expands access. The company was acquired, underscoring its traction in fintech and proptech.

With a lean team of two based in San Francisco and remote, Landed operates at the intersection of credit, lending, and real-estate technology.

startups.title: Emburse

Emburse is a San Francisco-based fintech platform offering expense management and accounts payable automation. The system gives businesses greater visibility and control over corporate spending by enabling them to deploy customizable payment cards.

Businesses can issue virtual or physical MasterCard-network branded expense cards directly to employees or contractors. This setup allows companies to authorize only pre-approved business expenses. The company participated in the Winter 2016 Y Combinator batch and has since been acquired.

startups.title: Plato
startups.description: Mentorship platform built to turn engineering and product managers into better leaders. YC W16.

Part of the Y Combinator Winter 2016 batch, the San Francisco-based B2B productivity company operated with a team of 26 across local and remote locations. Plato has since been acquired.

startups.title: Goodybag

Goodybag is an online catering platform that simplifies office meal delivery. Based in Austin, Texas, the platform gives businesses a central tool to explore local restaurant menus and arrange food delivery for team meetings and workplace events.

Partner vendors retain control over their operations by setting their own delivery fees and coverage zones. Originally part of the Y Combinator Winter 2016 batch, Goodybag has since been acquired.

startups.title: MineralSoft

MineralSoft is a data management platform built specifically for oil and gas mineral rights and royalty management. The platform caters to a wide spectrum of clients managing oil and gas interests, including investment funds, family offices, individual owners, and financial advisors. It aims to streamline administrative oversight and help users maximize the value of their energy portfolios.

MineralSoft has since been acquired. Prior to its acquisition, the company grew to a team of 35 employees.

startups.title: LendEDU

LendEDU operates a personal finance comparison website designed to bring transparency to consumer financial markets. The platform enables users to compare options across student lending, unsecured loans, auto loans, banking, credit cards, and various insurance products.

After participating in Y Combinator's Winter 2016 batch, LendEDU also graduated from the Iowa Startup Accelerator and received seed funding from Built By Iowa and the Iowa Startup Accelerator Fund. Its comparison tools and data were featured across major media outlets, including The Wall Street Journal, The New York Times, Bloomberg, and Forbes.

LendEDU has since been acquired.

startups.title: Able Health

Able Health provides a platform that helps physician organizations manage value-based care programs. Able Health simplifies program administration by tailoring workflows to specific reporting requirements and streamlining engagement between clinicians and health plans.

Based in San Francisco and launched in the Winter 2016 YC batch, the Healthcare IT company operated with a team of 11. Able Health has since been acquired.

startups.title: Clipboard

The platform is a leader in long-term care staffing and is expanding into home health and hospital settings. Founded in 2016, Clipboard has grown into a remote-first organization with a team of over 1,000 employees, helping hundreds of thousands of workers fill millions of shifts annually.

startups.title: Humi

startups.title: Peer5
startups.description: Builds a peer-to-peer content delivery network that optimizes live and on-demand video streaming. YC W17.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://www.peer5.com | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/peer5

Peer5 provides a peer-to-peer (P2P) content delivery network (CDN) designed to improve live and on-demand video streams. As video quality shifts toward HD and 4K, traditional CDNs can struggle with peak demand, forcing publishers to pay for underutilized server capacity. Peer5 works alongside existing servers, offloading bandwidth to a peer network so that the delivery network grows stronger as viewership increases. Peer5 has since been acquired.

The service leverages HTML5 and WebRTC, enabling P2P delivery inside end-user web browsers without requiring software or plugin installations. It integrates with content providers' existing setups and supports various streaming protocols, players, and media servers. On average, Peer5 offloads 70% of bandwidth, increases server capacity by 20x, extends viewing time by 30%, and decreases rebuffering instances by 40%.

startups.title: UpKeep

The service was created to address the drawbacks of existing alternatives, such as overpriced imported grocery stores and expensive package-forwarding companies. By leveraging technology, ZipX set out to make international commerce seamless and accessible.

ZipX participated in the Y Combinator Winter 2017 batch and has since been acquired.

Beyond basic UI automation, Preflight includes a Workflow feature for orchestrating dependent end-to-end test sequences. It also streamlines API test creation by prepopulating API tests directly from the network calls captured during UI test execution, enabling teams to set up API tests in minutes.

Preflight was part of the Y Combinator Winter 2019 batch and operated with a team in Chicago and remotely. The company has since been acquired.

Based in San Francisco with a remote workforce, Geosite employed around 40 people before the acquisition.

By offering doctor visits and telemedicine at the same price, Loop can lower premiums while giving employees better access to care, tapping into a $8 billion, 27% CAGR employer‑funded health insurance opportunity.

startups.title: Cortex AI
startups.description: Egocentric and robot training datasets from real workplaces for embodied AI. YC F25.
startups.prose:
Founded by [Lucas Ngoo](./Lucas%20Ngoo.md). Raised $6M. Builds high-quality training datasets for embodied AI — specifically egocentric video (first-person perspective) and robot data captured in real workplace environments, with hand and body pose annotations.

The training data bottleneck for robotics is acute: robots need to learn from demonstrations, but demonstration data is expensive, hard to collect, and usually captured in sterile lab environments. Cortex AI captures data in real factories, warehouses, and workplaces — messier but more representative of actual deployment conditions.

The annotation layer (hand pose, body pose, object interaction) is what separates Cortex AI from raw video: annotated data is what robots can actually learn from.

Sits in the same data infrastructure layer as [Ndea](./Ndea.md)'s training data philosophy — both companies believe the quality and type of training data matters as much as the architecture of the model being trained.

Aurorin uses a custom parametric and B-Rep driven CAD Kernel built to take full advantage of modern CPUs and GPUs. AI-native from the start — not bolted on to a legacy system.

startups.title: Pocket

startups.prose:
**Website:** heypocket.com | **Twitter:** @heypocket | **LinkedIn:** heypocketai

The revenue outlier of the entire W26 batch: **$27M ARR**, 30,000+ units shipped, 50% month-over-month growth — all within five months of launch. Raised $11M (June 2026).

A small clip-on device with 3 microphones and 1 button that captures, transcribes, and summarises in-person conversations, meetings, and phone calls with automatic to-do extraction. No app to open, no record button to press — it's always on.

The AI wearable graveyard is long: Google Glass, Amazon Echo Frames, Humane AI Pin. Pocket survived where others failed by solving one specific pain — forgotten conversations and untracked action items — rather than trying to replace the phone.

The 50% month-over-month retention through five months signals real behaviour change, not launch curiosity. Series A-level traction from a seed hardware company is essentially unprecedented in recent YC history.

startups.title: Fort
startups.description: Strength tracking wearable that measures muscle force directly during workouts. YC W26.
startups.prose:
Builds a wearable sensor system that measures actual muscle force output during strength training — not reps counted via accelerometer, not heart rate, but the actual contractile force that determines whether a workout stimulus is effective.

The technical distinction matters: two people performing the same exercise with the same weight can produce dramatically different muscle force outputs depending on tempo, range of motion, and neuromuscular activation. Existing wearables (Apple Watch, Whoop, Garmin) measure external proxies. Fort measures the signal that actually determines training adaptation.

The product reached 1,295 Twitter likes at launch — high for a fitness hardware company, suggesting genuine community interest from strength training enthusiasts who have been frustrated by the shallow data from existing wearables.

Competes for the same serious athlete audience as [Pocket](./Pocket.md) competes for the professional audience — both bet that a purpose-built hardware device extracts more value than a phone app trying to do the same thing.

Today, most hardware companies that need a custom chip have bad options: sign a massive contract with an incumbent like Broadcom, pay a traditional design house millions of dollars and wait 18+ months, or keep using off-the-shelf chips and FPGAs that are not optimized for their product's cost, power, performance, size, or manufacturability.

startups.title: OctaPulse
startups.description: CV and robotics to automate quality inspection in fish farms. YC W26.
startups.prose:
**Website:** https://www.tryoctapulse.com/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/octapulse

OctaPulse uses AI vision to automate hatchery QA for fish farms, starting with broodstock phenotyping and juvenile deformity inspection. OctaPulse cuts inspection time from about 5 minutes to under 30 seconds per fish, with more than 90 percent accuracy, so farms advance only high quality fish and waste less feed and labor. Its goal is to bring automation across the entire fish production lifecycle for the $300B aquaculture industry.

Aquaculture is the fastest growing food sector, and has already surpassed commercial fishing for production of seafood. Yet two of the most critical QA and QC steps in fish production are still done by hand: phenotyping and deformity inspection. These processes are slow, error prone, and despised by technicians but vital for the success of the farm, so much so that farms spend >$200K a year on trained technicians and geneticists to operate. We’ve built an AI vision platform for vertically integrated finfish farms that drops into existing workflows starting in the hatchery, uses off the shelf cameras, standardizes these QA steps, and creates a proprietary multi species dataset that becomes the brain for future autonomous aquafarms. Phenotyping is the start, but the platform is designed to be a drop in solution that can easily expand into feeding, health monitoring, and processing so it cans solve production problems across the lifecycle.

It signeds a 6-figure paid pilot with the largest trout producer in the United States, are deploying into 2 more farms early 2026, and trained models above 90 percent accuracy while cutting inspection time from 5 minutes to under 30 seconds. Each deployment adds labeled images to its dataset and improves cross species generalization.

startups.title: One Robot

**Website:** https://www.onerobot.io/ | **YC:** https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/one-robot

One Robot builds simulation environments that are realistic to see and realistic to interact with, so robotics teams can train and evaluate robot policies without being bottlenecked by robot time.

Today, improving a VLA often means more real-world hours: setting up the scene, running trials, resetting, and repeating. This loop is slow, expensive, and hard to scale. For example, material handling and manufacturing assembly tasks, models need far more training and evaluation data than teams can collect in the real world.

One Robot uses task-specific data to build world model-based simulation environments for hard manipulation tasks (for example, textiles and box folding). These environments help teams run more training and evals, find failure modes faster, and accelerate iteration on action policies with less dependence on real-world data collection and robot availability.

startups.title: GrazeMate

startups.prose:

Cattle ranching across the US involves monitoring animals spread across tens of thousands of acres. A rancher with 500 head of cattle can spend hours daily on patrol that produces limited data. GrazeMate replaces that patrol with continuous autonomous coverage and computer vision identification of each animal.

The practical problems being solved: early disease detection (an animal behaving differently before showing physical symptoms), grazing rotation optimization (moving herds before pasture is overgrazed), and accurate headcount (theft and stray detection).

The market is large and ignored: US cattle industry is $100B+, technology adoption is low, and precision agriculture software has focused on crops, not livestock.

1,210 Twitter likes at launch — high engagement for an agricultural tech product, suggesting significant rancher interest in the category.

GrazeMate sits in the same W26 hardware cluster as [Pocket](./Pocket.md) and [Fort](./Fort.md) — all three bet that purpose-built physical devices extract value that software-only solutions can't reach.
