Hyper has helped turn more than 100 communities into businesses generating tens of thousands in annual revenue, raising a $17.2M Series A in 2021 and a further $6M seed in 2025.

startups.title: Denis Mars
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Proxy, a smart ring digital wallet and identity platform.
startups.prose:
**LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/in/denismars

Co-founded [Proxy](./Proxy.md) with [Simon Ratner](./Simon%20Ratner.md), building a universal digital identity signal meant to make physical-world interactions frictionless. Mars holds a BS in Physics and BE Honours in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Sydney, later studying at Stanford. A three-time founder with three exits, he previously founded Meetings.io (acquired by Jive) and was a former Director of Admissions at Y Combinator.

startups.title: Simon Ratner
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Proxy, a smart ring digital wallet and identity platform, later acquired by Oura.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Proxy](./Proxy.md) as CTO with [Denis Mars](./Denis%20Mars.md) in YC's Summer 2016 batch. Ratner holds a Master's in Electrical Engineering from Stanford and dual Bachelor's degrees in Software Engineering and Biochemistry from the University of Sydney. He previously co-founded Omnisio (acquired by Google) and worked as an engineer at Jive Software and YouTube. Proxy was later acquired by Oura, where Ratner now heads engineering for future technologies.

startups.title: Alexandr Wang
startups.description: Founder of Scale AI, a data platform accelerating AI development, later Meta's Chief AI Officer.
startups.prose: Founded [Scale AI](./Scale%20AI.md) at 19 after a brief stint studying machine learning at MIT, dropping out to join Y Combinator and build a data-labeling platform that became core infrastructure for OpenAI, Meta, Microsoft, autonomous vehicle companies, and the U.S. government. Wang became the world's youngest self-made billionaire running Scale. In June 2025, Meta acquired 49% of Scale AI at a roughly $29B valuation, and Wang left to become Meta's Chief AI Officer.

startups.title: Charlie Cheever
startups.description: Co-founder of Expo, a framework for building universal iOS/Android/web apps, and co-founder of Quora.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Expo](./Expo.md) with [James Ide](./James%20Ide.md), a framework and cloud platform (EAS) used by Airbnb, Bluesky, Walmart, SpaceX, and Tesla to build apps that run on iOS, Android, and web from one JavaScript codebase. Cheever, a Harvard CS graduate, previously worked as an SDE at Amazon, then as an engineer and manager at Facebook where he built Facebook Connect and the Facebook Platform, before co-founding Quora with Adam D'Angelo in 2009.

startups.title: James Ide
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Expo, a framework for building universal iOS/Android/web apps.
startups.prose:
**LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/in/idejames

Co-founded [Expo](./Expo.md) as CTO with [Charlie Cheever](./Charlie%20Cheever.md) in YC's Summer 2016 batch, making universal mobile app development easier to build and use. Ide studied at UC Berkeley.

startups.title: Justin Vencel
startups.description: Co-founder of Solve, airport fast-track and concierge services, later acquired by Blacklane.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Solve](./Solve.md) with Blaine Vess and Shawn Sheikh, providing fast-track, customs, and concierge services across 470+ airports worldwide. Solve went through YC's Summer 2017 batch and was acquired by Blacklane, a global chauffeur service, in October 2017.

startups.title: Julián Cantú
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Eden, an AI-native diagnostic and radiology platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Eden](./Eden.md) with [Raymundo Gonzalez](./Raymundo%20Gonzalez.md), building the leading AI-and-cloud-native Diagnostic OS in Latin America, serving over 2,600 medical institutions across 18 countries. Cantú studied Physics Engineering at Tecnológico de Monterrey before dropping out to pursue health tech, later becoming a Thiel Fellow; he was inspired to found Eden after living through his mother's breast cancer diagnosis at age 8, which exposed him to the health system's diagnostic shortcomings.

startups.title: Raymundo Gonzalez
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Eden, an AI-native diagnostic and radiology platform.
startups.prose:
**LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/in/raymundo-gzz

Co-founded [Eden](./Eden.md) as CTO with [Julián Cantú](./Juli%C3%A1n%20Cant%C3%BA.md). Gonzalez holds a BS in Computational Sciences, Data Science, and Statistics from Minerva University (2019), with earlier research internships at Stanford and Audible.

startups.title: Matt Marcus
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Modern Treasury, payment operations software.
startups.prose:
**LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/in/matthew-marcus-bb1b9460

Co-founded [Modern Treasury](./Modern%20Treasury.md) with [Dimitri Dadiomov](./Dimitri%20Dadiomov.md) and [Sam Aarons](./Sam%20Aarons.md) in 2018. Marcus holds a BS in Computer Science from Dartmouth, where he captained the men's lightweight rowing team, and previously worked at First Round Capital and Ultimate Kronos Group before building payment products at Kiavi (formerly LendingHome), the pain points of which directly inspired Modern Treasury.

startups.title: Dimitri Dadiomov
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Modern Treasury, payment operations software.
startups.prose:
**LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/in/dadiomov

Co-founded [Modern Treasury](./Modern%20Treasury.md) with [Matt Marcus](./Matt%20Marcus.md) and [Sam Aarons](./Sam%20Aarons.md) in 2018. Dadiomov holds a BA in Economics and BS in Energy Science & Technology from Stanford, and an MBA from Harvard Business School (2015). Before Modern Treasury, he was a Principal PM at LendingHome (now Kiavi) building payment operations.

startups.title: Sam Aarons
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Modern Treasury, payment operations software.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Modern Treasury](./Modern%20Treasury.md) as CTO with [Dimitri Dadiomov](./Dimitri%20Dadiomov.md) and [Matt Marcus](./Matt%20Marcus.md) in 2018. Aarons earned his BS from Columbia, where he worked on hacking projects, before building the payment operations infrastructure that lets companies move and track money with confidence.

startups.title: Andrew Parker
startups.description: Founder and CEO of Papa, a one-stop shop for flexible family care.
startups.prose: Founded [Papa](./Papa.md) in 2017 to help older adults and their families stay independent while aging at home, pairing them with "Papa Pals" for companionship and everyday tasks. Parker holds a Bachelor's in Finance from Florida State and a Certified Employee Benefit Specialist certification from Wharton, and previously ran Health Systems Sales and Strategy at MDLive as one of its first 15 employees.

startups.title: Andrew Antos
startups.description: Founder and CEO of Within (formerly Klarity), an AI company for enterprise workflow coordination.
startups.prose: Founded [Within](./Within.md) (originally Klarity) with [Nischal Nadhamuni](./Nischal%20Nadhamuni.md), whom he met in an MIT entrepreneurship class. Antos holds a law degree from Harvard. What started as Klarity in YC's Summer 2018 batch has evolved into Within, partnering with Fortune 500 companies like ServiceNow, JLL, and Moody's, and with OpenAI, DoorDash, Uber, and Stripe.

startups.title: Nischal Nadhamuni
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Within (formerly Klarity), an AI company for enterprise workflow coordination.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Within](./Within.md) as CTO with [Andrew Antos](./Andrew%20Antos.md), meeting him in MIT's 15.390 Entrepreneurship class as an undergrad (CS, 2018). Before founding the company, Nadhamuni worked on AI projects at Flipkart (building fraud-detection systems), Massachusetts General Hospital, and Airware. He was named to Forbes' 30 Under 30 in AI in 2025.

startups.title: Kumail Jaffer
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Gather, a virtual space platform for meeting online.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Gather](./Gather.md) as CTO with [Phillip Wang](./Phillip%20Wang.md) in 2020, part of YC's Summer 2019 batch, building virtual spaces for online meetings and events. Jaffer holds a Computer Science degree from Carnegie Mellon.

startups.title: Phillip Wang
startups.description: CEO and co-founder of Gather, a virtual space platform for meeting online.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Gather](./Gather.md) with [Kumail Jaffer](./Kumail%20Jaffer.md). Wang studied computer science at Carnegie Mellon, where he also spent nearly four years as a part-time deep learning researcher, and previously worked at Facebook, Cruise, and Microsoft before starting Gather.

startups.title: Alex Hilleary
startups.description: Member of the founding team at Gather, a virtual space platform for meeting online.
startups.prose: Part of the founding team at [Gather](./Gather.md), which builds virtual spaces for online meetings, styled as a 2D game map with spatial, proximity-based conversations, alongside [Kumail Jaffer](./Kumail%20Jaffer.md) and [Phillip Wang](./Phillip%20Wang.md).

startups.title: Brooks Sime
startups.description: Member of the founding team at Gather, a virtual space platform for meeting online.
startups.prose: Part of the founding team at [Gather](./Gather.md), building virtual spaces for online meetings and events alongside [Kumail Jaffer](./Kumail%20Jaffer.md) and [Phillip Wang](./Phillip%20Wang.md).

startups.title: John Wetzel
startups.description: Member of the founding team at Gather, a virtual space platform for meeting online.
startups.prose: Part of the founding team at [Gather](./Gather.md), building virtual spaces for online meetings and events alongside [Kumail Jaffer](./Kumail%20Jaffer.md) and [Phillip Wang](./Phillip%20Wang.md).

startups.title: Khaled Kteily
startups.description: Founder and CEO of Legacy, a digital male fertility clinic.
startups.prose:
**LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/company/givelegacy

Founded [Legacy](./Legacy.md) out of Harvard Innovation Labs in 2018, helping men test, improve, and freeze sperm through mail-in kits analyzed at a CLIA-certified andrology lab, going through YC's Summer 2019 batch. Kteily, a Canadian-Lebanese entrepreneur, holds a Bachelor of Commerce from McGill and a Master in Public Policy from Harvard Kennedy School on a full scholarship. Legacy has raised $45M from investors including celebrities Justin Bieber, DJ Khaled, The Weeknd, and Orlando Bloom.

startups.title: Sarah Steinle
startups.description: Co-founder and COO of Legacy, a digital male fertility clinic.
startups.prose:
**LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/in/sarah-steinle-66142a3b

Co-founded [Legacy](./Legacy.md) with [Khaled Kteily](./Khaled%20Kteily.md) out of Harvard, part of YC's Summer 2019 batch. Steinle, a Middlebury College graduate, serves as COO, overseeing client experience for Legacy's at-home sperm testing, improvement, and freezing services.

startups.title: Jordan Gonen
startups.description: CEO and co-founder of Compound, a wealth manager for tech employees.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Compound](./Compound.md) with [Jacob Schein](./Jacob%20Schein.md), whom he met at Washington University in St. Louis, building a wealth management platform for tech employees to manage equity, invest, and get financial advice — part of YC's 2019 class. Compound later merged with Alternativ Wealth to form Compound Planning, a digital family office managing roughly $1.1B in assets.

startups.title: Jacob Schein
startups.description: Co-founder of Compound, a wealth manager for tech employees.
startups.prose:
**LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/in/jacob-schein

Co-founded [Compound](./Compound.md) with [Jordan Gonen](./Jordan%20Gonen.md), meeting him at Washington University in St. Louis; he also studied at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. Compound helped tech employees and high-net-worth individuals manage stock options and personal finances before merging into Compound Planning.

startups.title: Naveen Qureshi
startups.description: Co-founder and former CEO of Sable, a digital bank for internationals new to the US.
startups.prose:
**LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/in/naveen-qureshi

Co-founded [Sable](./Sable.md) in 2019 with Towers Wilen, Andrej Paule, and [Joseph Finlayson](./Joseph%20Finlayson.md), meeting her co-founders at Columbia Business School (Laidlaw Scholar MBA). After moving to New York and being unable to get a US credit card despite a strong Canadian credit history, Qureshi built Sable to let internationals open US bank accounts and get credit without a Social Security Number. Sable grew to a few hundred thousand accounts and was sold; she's now co-founder and CEO of Rapidfolio, AI for fintechs and banks.

startups.title: Joseph Finlayson
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Sable, a digital bank for internationals new to the US.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Sable](./Sable.md) as CTO in 2019 with [Naveen Qureshi](./Naveen%20Qureshi.md), Towers Wilen, and Andrej Paule, part of YC's Summer 2019 batch. Finlayson, a University of Leeds graduate, previously worked as a Digital Consultant at McKinsey & Company before building Sable's banking infrastructure for internationals without US credit history.

startups.title: Towers Wilen
startups.description: Co-founder of Sable, a digital bank for internationals new to the US.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Sable](./Sable.md) in 2019 with [Naveen Qureshi](./Naveen%20Qureshi.md), Andrej Paule, and [Joseph Finlayson](./Joseph%20Finlayson.md), meeting his co-founders at Columbia Business School. Wilen studied at the University of Texas at Austin before earning his MBA at Columbia, and helped build Sable's banking product for internationals without US credit history.

startups.title: Oren Friedman
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Rally, a platform for user research operations.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Rally](./Rally.md) as CEO with [Alec Robins](./Alec%20Robins.md), building a platform to help teams run and manage user research at scale. Friedman studied at Vanderbilt University before starting the company.

startups.title: Alec Robins
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Rally, a platform for user research operations.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Rally](./Rally.md) as CTO with [Oren Friedman](./Oren%20Friedman.md). Robins studied computer science at Vanderbilt University and also spent time at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, and previously worked as an engineer at Facebook and HubSpot before building Rally's research-ops platform.

startups.title: Fitz Nowlan
startups.description: Co-founder of Reflect, an automated meeting-notes and workflow platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Reflect](./Reflect.md) with [Todd McNeal](./Todd%20McNeal.md), building tools to automatically capture and organize meeting notes and follow-up work. Nowlan holds a PhD in Computer Science from Yale. Reflect was later acquired by SmartBear.

startups.title: Todd McNeal
startups.description: Co-founder of Reflect, an automated meeting-notes and workflow platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Reflect](./Reflect.md) with [Fitz Nowlan](./Fitz%20Nowlan.md). McNeal, a Villanova University graduate, was previously part of the founding team at Curalate before building Reflect, which was later acquired by SmartBear.

startups.title: Yunyu Lin
startups.description: Co-founder of Cohere.io, a customer-support automation platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Cohere.io](./Cohere.io.md) (unrelated to the AI lab of the same name), building tools to automate customer support workflows. Cohere.io was later acquired by Ramp, where the technology now powers parts of Ramp's own product.

startups.title: Rahul Sengottuvelu
startups.description: Co-founder of Cohere.io, a customer-support automation platform, now CTO of Ramp.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Cohere.io](./Cohere.io.md) with [Yunyu Lin](./Yunyu%20Lin.md), a customer-support automation startup later acquired by Ramp. Sengottuvelu, a Duke University graduate, now serves as CTO of Ramp, continuing to build on the technology and team from Cohere.io.

startups.title: Chris Osborn
startups.description: Founder of Dialect, a developer platform for on-chain actions on Solana.
startups.prose: Founded [Dialect](./Dialect.md), building developer infrastructure for triggering on-chain actions and notifications on the Solana blockchain. Osborn holds a PhD in Physics from Columbia University.

startups.title: Shantanu Joshi
startups.description: Co-founder of Lume, a healthcare staffing and workforce platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Lume](./Lume.md), building technology for healthcare staffing and workforce management. Lume was later acquired by Vivian Health, a healthcare staffing marketplace.

startups.title: Victor Cardenas
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Slash, a business banking and payments platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Slash](./Slash.md) as CEO with [Kevin Bai](./Kevin%20Bai.md), building business banking and payments infrastructure for startups and small businesses. Cardenas left Stanford as a Thiel Fellow to build the company, which has reached a $1.4B valuation.

startups.title: Kevin Bai
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Slash, a business banking and payments platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Slash](./Slash.md) as CTO with [Victor Cardenas](./Victor%20Cardenas.md), leaving the University of Waterloo's computer science program to build the company's banking and payments infrastructure.

startups.title: Alfonso Lizárraga
startups.description: Founder of Hilos, a WhatsApp-based customer communication platform for Latin America.
startups.prose: Founded [Hilos](./Hilos.md), building WhatsApp-based automation and customer communication tools for businesses across Latin America. Lizárraga studied mechatronics engineering at UNAM and previously worked at Stripe before starting the company.

startups.title: Vladimir Korshin
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Level, a home financial services platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Level](./Level.md) as CEO, building home financial services and equity products for homeowners. Korshin, a University of Washington graduate, previously worked at Silicon Valley Bank, Facebook, Eventbrite, and Niantic before starting the company.

startups.title: Ty Dunn
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Continue, an open-source AI coding assistant.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Continue](./Continue.md) as CEO, building an open-source AI coding assistant that plugs into developers' existing editors. Continue went through YC's Summer 2023 batch and has grown to over 23,000 stars on GitHub.

startups.title: Christopher Chang
startups.description: Co-founder of Lume, a fintech banking app for nurses, acquired by Vivian Health.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Lume](./Lume.md) in 2019, a banking app for nurses offering earned wage access, student loan refinancing, and travel nurse jobs. Chang holds a Computer Science degree from Columbia University. After Lume was acquired by Vivian Health in 2022, he joined Vivian Health with co-founder Shantanu Joshi to lead product and engineering for new financial products for healthcare workers.

startups.title: Robert Ross
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Lume, a no-code AI tool for data mapping and integration.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Lume](./Lume.md) as CEO in 2022 with Nicolas Machado and Nebyou Zewde, meeting his co-founders in their freshman dorm at Stanford. Lume (YC W23) is a no-code tool that uses AI to automatically generate and maintain custom data integrations between any start and end schema.

startups.title: Nicolas Machado
startups.description: Co-founder of Lume, a no-code AI tool for data mapping and integration.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Lume](./Lume.md) with Robert Ross and Nebyou Zewde, whom he met during his first year at Stanford studying Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, where he also served as Class President. Before Lume, Machado worked as a Product Manager at Meta on Oculus VR and gained venture capital experience at Romulus Capital.

startups.title: Nebyou Zewde
startups.description: Co-founder of Lume, a no-code AI tool for data mapping and integration.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Lume](./Lume.md) with Robert Ross and Nicolas Machado, whom he met in their freshman dorm at Stanford. Before Lume, Zewde brought experience from roles at Opendoor and GGV Capital. As engineers, the three co-founders had personally felt the pain of manually mapping data between systems, which became the problem Lume set out to solve.

startups.title: Theodoric Chew
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Intellect, a global mental healthcare company.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Intellect](./Intellect.md) as CEO in 2020 with [Anurag Chutani](./Anurag%20Chutani.md), building a mental healthcare system for global workforces and payors that went through YC's Summer 2021 batch. Intellect has grown into the global leader in hyperlocalized mental healthcare, serving 4 million lives across enterprise employers, insurers, healthcare systems, and governments in over 50 languages and 100 countries. Chew was named to the World Economic Forum's Young Global Leaders Class of 2026.

startups.title: Anurag Chutani
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Intellect, a global mental healthcare company.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Intellect](./Intellect.md) as CTO with [Theodoric Chew](./Theodoric%20Chew.md) in 2020. Chutani holds a Bachelor's in Electronics and Communication Engineering and previously led engineering teams at early-to-growth-stage startups including CARS24 and Wadi before building Intellect's mental healthcare platform.

startups.title: Gus Trigos
startups.description: Founder of Mentum, an AI-powered assistant for procurement and strategic sourcing, acquired by Nuvocargo.
startups.prose: Founded [Mentum](./Mentum.md) in 2021, an AI-powered assistant for procurement and strategic sourcing that went through YC's Summer 2021 batch. Trigos previously worked as an AI quant at BlackRock. Mentum was later acquired by Nuvocargo, where Trigos joined to strengthen the company's R&D organization and AI agent roadmap for logistics.

startups.title: Molly Hogan
startups.description: Co-founder of Level, a fintech underwriting platform for startups, acquired by Vouch.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Level](./Level.md) in January 2021 with [Vladimir Korshin](./Vladimir%20Korshin.md) and [Asa Schachar](./Asa%20Schachar.md), part of YC's Summer 2021 batch. Level built a tech-driven underwriting process for early-stage fintech companies raising debt. Before Level, Hogan led new and international product initiatives at Amazon for over seven years. After Level was acquired by Vouch in 2023, she became a Senior Manager of Product at Remitly.

startups.title: Asa Schachar
startups.description: Co-founder of Level, a fintech underwriting platform acquired by Vouch; now CTO of Voicepanel.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Level](./Level.md) as CTO in 2021 with [Molly Hogan](./Molly%20Hogan.md) and [Vladimir Korshin](./Vladimir%20Korshin.md), part of YC's Summer 2021 batch, before it was acquired by Vouch in 2023. Schachar holds a degree in Applied Mathematics & Computer Science from Harvard, started his engineering career at Microsoft, and later managed engineering teams at Optimizely. He is now co-founder and CTO of Voicepanel (YC W24), which builds AI agents for customer research.

startups.title: Peter Tribelhorn
startups.description: Co-founder of Hera, an AI motion design platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Hera](./Hera.md) with [Chia-Lun Wu](./Chia-Lun%20Wu.md), building an AI tool that makes motion design radically faster and cheaper — users have created over 50,000 animations, with more than 200,000 created in the first two weeks after launch. Before Hera, Tribelhorn worked in investment banking after studying at WHU, then joined Lunar X, where he acquired and scaled YouTube channels like Economics Explained and The Game Theorists to over 30 million subscribers, repeatedly hitting the same bottleneck: slow, expensive animation production.

startups.title: Chia-Lun Wu
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Hera, an AI motion design platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Hera](./Hera.md) as CTO with [Peter Tribelhorn](./Peter%20Tribelhorn.md), part of YC's Summer 2025 batch. Wu was one of the first engineers at Vyond, where he built Vyond Studio, an online video editor used by 20,000 businesses, and has 11 years of experience shipping systems in fintech, logistics, and media across roles at Flagright, Alloy, and Forto.

startups.title: Marius Montmany
startups.description: Co-founder of REVER, an e-commerce returns and refunds platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [REVER](./REVER.md) in 2022 with [Oriol Hernandez i Fajula](./Oriol%20Hernandez%20i%20Fajula.md) in Barcelona, part of YC's Summer 2022 batch, after both grew frustrated with "reverse logistics" — the difficulty of handling product returns efficiently. Montmany previously worked at Glovo from 2018 to 2020, including as Global Head of Product & Logistics. REVER makes e-commerce returns possible in two clicks with refunds in 24 hours, and has raised $15 million.

startups.title: Oriol Hernandez i Fajula
startups.description: Co-founder of REVER, an e-commerce returns and refunds platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [REVER](./REVER.md) with [Marius Montmany](./Marius%20Montmany.md) in Barcelona in 2022, part of YC's Summer 2022 batch, after both became frustrated with inefficient reverse logistics while working at large logistics companies. Before REVER, Hernandez i Fajula worked in management consulting at Boston Consulting Group and in investment banking at Bank of America Merrill Lynch, and has been a VC investor at BlackWood Capital Partners since 2022.

startups.title: Deepak Singla
startups.description: Co-founder of Fini, an AI customer support platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Fini](./Fini.md) with [Hakim K](./Hakim%20K.md), part of YC's Winter 2022 batch, leading product strategy for AI agents that autonomously resolve up to 80% of enterprise customer support tickets. Singla holds a degree in Mechanical Engineering with a minor in Business Management from IIT Delhi. At Uber, he built a cross-sell strategy on the Rides platform that generated over $100 million in revenue, and he and Hakim led product and growth teams there at the scale of 200 million-plus support tickets a year before founding Fini.

startups.title: Hakim K
startups.description: Co-founder of Fini, an AI customer support platform.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Fini](./Fini.md) with [Deepak Singla](./Deepak%20Singla.md), part of YC's Winter 2022 batch. Hakim, originally from Sweden, holds a master's degree in Engineering Mathematics from École Polytechnique and brings 10-plus years of software engineering and analytics experience, most recently at Uber, where he met Singla.

startups.title: Anand Chaturvedi
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of dili, AI automation for compliance in construction and infrastructure.
startups.prose: Co-founded [dili](./dili.md) as CEO with [Brian Fernandez](./Brian%20Fernandez.md) and Stephanie Song, part of YC's Summer 2023 batch, building AI automation for compliance in energy, infrastructure, data centers, and construction. The co-founders met while working together at Coinbase, where Chaturvedi led engagement growth, increasing revenue by $50M and building out KYC/AML systems. dili has helped customers secure over $1 billion in federal funding through automated prevailing wage and labor compliance.

startups.title: Brian Fernandez
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of dili, AI automation for compliance in construction and infrastructure.
startups.prose: Co-founded [dili](./dili.md) as CTO with [Anand Chaturvedi](./Anand%20Chaturvedi.md), part of YC's Summer 2023 batch, building AI automation that combines with expert compliance teams to handle prevailing wage and Davis-Bacon requirements for large infrastructure projects. dili has raised $3.5M from investors including Y Combinator, Allianz, and Rebel Fund.

startups.title: Civan Ozseyhan
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of refine, an open-source enterprise app framework.
startups.prose: Co-founded [refine](./refine.md) as CEO in 2022 with [Omer Aplak](./Omer%20Aplak.md) and [Eren Erkalkan](./Eren%20Erkalkan.md), part of YC's Summer 2023 batch, building an open-source, headless React framework for rapidly building enterprise web applications. Ozseyhan is a serial entrepreneur with 15-plus years of experience building enterprise software, and previously co-founded Fixie Digital GmbH from 2016 to 2022.

startups.title: Omer Aplak
startups.description: Co-founder of refine, an open-source enterprise app framework; now CEO of VoltAgent.
startups.prose: Co-founded [refine](./refine.md) as CTO with [Civan Ozseyhan](./Civan%20Ozseyhan.md) and [Eren Erkalkan](./Eren%20Erkalkan.md), part of YC's Summer 2023 batch. Aplak started his professional software career in high school and dropped out of university after his first year. In 2018 he co-founded Pankod Yazılım ve Danışmanlık, a software development house in Istanbul, before starting refine. He is now CEO of VoltAgent, building a JavaScript framework.

startups.title: Eren Erkalkan
startups.description: Co-founder of refine, an open-source enterprise app framework.
startups.prose: Co-founded [refine](./refine.md) as Head of Product with [Civan Ozseyhan](./Civan%20Ozseyhan.md) and [Omer Aplak](./Omer%20Aplak.md), part of YC's Summer 2023 batch. Erkalkan studied Civil Engineering at Istanbul Technical University and co-founded Pankod Yazılım ve Danışmanlık alongside Aplak in 2018 before starting refine.

startups.title: Olivier Moindrot
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Fragment, an AI workflow platform acquired by Sierra.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Fragment](./Fragment.md) as CEO, part of YC's Summer 2023 batch, helping businesses integrate AI into their workflows. Moindrot ranked first in the entrance exam at École Polytechnique and studied at Stanford, and previously created and led the AI team at MetaMap. Fragment was acquired by Bret Taylor's Sierra in April 2026, with Moindrot joining Sierra's team to strengthen its agent development in France.

startups.title: Guillaume Genthial
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Fragment, an AI workflow platform acquired by Sierra.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Fragment](./Fragment.md) as CTO with [Olivier Moindrot](./Olivier%20Moindrot.md), part of YC's Summer 2023 batch, helping operations teams in fintechs and insurtechs integrate AI. Genthial studied at Stanford and previously led the AI team at a KYC provider, with prior experience at Criteo AI Lab, Roam Analytics, and the Stanford Machine Learning Group. He joined Sierra alongside Moindrot after Sierra acquired Fragment in April 2026.

startups.title: Nate Sesti
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Continue, an open-source AI coding assistant.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Continue](./Continue.md) as CTO with [Ty Dunn](./Ty%20Dunn.md) in June 2023, building an open-source, customizable coding autopilot that continuously learns from development data. Sesti studied math and physics at MIT (class of 2024), was the first hire at Mayan (YC W21), and previously worked on mission control software at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory.

startups.title: Mukund Jha
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Emergent, an AI platform that turns plain English into working apps.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Emergent](./Emergent.md) as CEO with his twin brother [Madhav Jha](./Madhav%20Jha.md), part of YC's Summer 2024 batch, building an AI-powered platform that turns plain-English descriptions into fully functional web and mobile apps without coding. Jha dropped out of a PhD program to found the company, is a graduate of Columbia Engineering, and previously co-founded and served as CTO of Dunzo. Emergent raised $100M from Khosla Ventures, SoftBank, Google, and others, reaching $50M ARR within 7 months of public launch.

startups.title: Madhav Jha
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Emergent, an AI platform that turns plain English into working apps.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Emergent](./Emergent.md) as CTO with his twin brother [Mukund Jha](./Mukund%20Jha.md), part of YC's Summer 2024 batch. Madhav studied at Penn State University and previously worked as a Senior Software Engineer at Sigma Computing before co-founding Emergent, which has since raised $130M at a $1.5B valuation.

startups.title: Mayank Mehta
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Pulse, a crowdsourced knowledge marketplace for IT executives.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Pulse](./Pulse.md) as CEO in 2017 with [Anand Thaker](./Anand%20Thaker.md) in San Francisco, part of YC's 2018 batch, building a crowdsourced knowledge marketplace connecting C-Suite technology executives with vendors. Companies including Salesforce, Microsoft, Okta, and Dialpad have relied on Pulse to inform their strategy, content, and marketing teams.

startups.title: Anand Thaker
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Pulse, a crowdsourced knowledge marketplace for IT executives.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Pulse](./Pulse.md) as CTO in 2017 with [Mayank Mehta](./Mayank%20Mehta.md) in San Francisco, part of YC's 2018 batch, building a peer-to-peer network letting IT leaders learn directly from each other. After scaling Pulse through YC and leading it to acquisition, Thaker became managing vice president of engineering at Gartner's Peer Programs.

startups.title: Josh Wymer
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of Central, back-office software for startups, acquired by Mercury.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Central](./Central.md) as CEO in April 2023 with [Pranav Kashyap](./Pranav%20Kashyap.md) and [Nilay Modi](./Nilay%20Modi.md), part of YC's Summer 2024 batch, consolidating payroll, benefits, state compliance, accounting, and R&D tax credits for startups. Wymer was the 12th employee at Mixpanel, where he ran product engineering and helped scale it past a $1B valuation, and also worked as a software engineer at Meta and played baseball at Virginia Tech. Central was later acquired by Mercury.

startups.title: Pranav Kashyap
startups.description: Co-founder of Central, back-office software for startups, acquired by Mercury.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Central](./Central.md) as COO with [Josh Wymer](./Josh%20Wymer.md) and [Nilay Modi](./Nilay%20Modi.md), part of YC's Summer 2024 batch. Kashyap holds a Computer Science degree from IIT Bombay and an MBA from Wharton, and previously built payment and tax products at Stripe, rebuilt Mixpanel's self-serve and messaging products, and worked with technology companies at McKinsey and Sequoia Capital.

startups.title: Nilay Modi
startups.description: Co-founder of Central, back-office software for startups, acquired by Mercury.
startups.prose: Co-founded [Central](./Central.md) with [Josh Wymer](./Josh%20Wymer.md) and [Pranav Kashyap](./Pranav%20Kashyap.md) in January 2023, focusing on product and design, part of YC's Summer 2024 batch. Modi is a two-time YC founder, having previously co-founded Clayboard, a virtual workshop platform backed by YC's Winter 2020 batch, before starting Central, which was later acquired by Mercury.

startups.title: Catherine Jue
startups.description: Co-founder and CEO of KERNEL, open-source infrastructure for AI agents to use the internet.
startups.prose:
**Twitter:** @juecd__ | **LinkedIn:** www.linkedin.com/in/juecd

Co-founded [KERNEL](./KERNEL.md) as CEO with [Rafael Garcia](./Rafael%20Garcia.md), building fast, open-source browser infrastructure that lets AI agents use the internet. Jue was previously a co-founder at Sway Finance, part of YC's Summer 2016 batch.

startups.title: Rafael Garcia
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of KERNEL, open-source infrastructure for AI agents to use the internet.
startups.prose:
**Twitter:** @rfgarcia | **LinkedIn:** www.linkedin.com/in/rafgarcia/

Co-founded [KERNEL](./KERNEL.md) as CTO with [Catherine Jue](./Catherine%20Jue.md), building fast browser infrastructure for AI agents. Garcia was previously co-founder and CTO of Clever, part of YC's Summer 2012 batch, which exited for $500 million.

startups.title: Pietro Zullo
startups.description: Founder and CEO of Manufact, cloud infrastructure for MCP servers and AI apps.
startups.prose:
**Twitter:** @pietrozullo | **LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/in/pietrozullo

Founded [Manufact](./Manufact.md) (formerly mcp-use) as CEO with [Luigi Pederzani](./Luigi%20Pederzani.md), part of YC's Summer 2025 batch, building cloud infrastructure for MCP servers and Claude/ChatGPT apps.

startups.title: Luigi Pederzani
startups.description: Co-founder and CTO of Manufact, cloud infrastructure for MCP servers and AI apps.
startups.prose:
**Twitter:** @pederzh | **LinkedIn:** www.linkedin.com/in/luigipederzani

Co-founded [Manufact](./Manufact.md) (formerly mcp-use) as CTO with [Pietro Zullo](./Pietro%20Zullo.md), part of YC's Summer 2025 batch. Pederzani holds an MSc in Computer Science and Engineering from Politecnico di Milano, was a founding engineer at Morgen (an ETH spin-off used by teams at Spotify, GitHub, Linear, and Canva), and led a 12-engineer team delivering multi-million-dollar projects at Accenture Switzerland. He was previously a YouTube creator with 150K subscribers and 15M-plus views.
